description: This source file defines a React component for a career multiverse exploration page. It includes UI elements such as filters, a branching map visualization, and an informational panel about selected career roles. The file also contains components like icons and progress rings, and manages state related to filtering, selection, and data display.

methods.name: isNodeInFilters
methods.description: Filters a node based on the current filter criteria, including path type, industry, and timeline.

methods.name: useLocalStorageSet
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages a set stored in localStorage, syncing state with local storage.

methods.name: IconStar
methods.description: React component rendering a star icon, filled or outline based on the 'filled' prop.

methods.name: ProgressRing
methods.description: React component rendering a circular progress ring indicating a percentage value.

methods.name: MultiverseStepPage
methods.description: Main React component implementing the career multiverse exploration page, including state management, event handlers, and rendering logic for the visualization, filters, and role intelligence panel.
